source: USDA FoodKeeper (public domain, CC0 1.0) - FSIS FoodKeeper Data v128
title: Thịt ba chỉ (五花肉, pork loin chops) — refrigerator and freezer storage
content: Fresh pork loin chops, bone-in (Thịt ba chỉ, 五花肉): refrigerate 3-5 days from date of purchase; freeze 4-12 months from date of purchase.

source: USDA FoodKeeper (public domain, CC0 1.0) - FSIS FoodKeeper Data v128
title: Thịt gà (鸡肉, whole chicken) — refrigerator and freezer storage
content: Whole chicken (Thịt gà, 鸡肉): refrigerate 1-2 days from date of purchase; freeze 12 months from date of purchase.

source: USDA FoodKeeper (public domain, CC0 1.0) - FSIS FoodKeeper Data v128
title: Thịt bò (牛肉, beef steaks) — refrigerator and freezer storage
content: Beef steaks (Thịt bò, 牛肉): refrigerate 3-5 days from date of purchase; freeze 4-12 months from date of purchase.

source: USDA FoodKeeper (public domain, CC0 1.0) - FSIS FoodKeeper Data v128
title: Cá (鱼, lean fish) — refrigerator and freezer storage
content: Lean fish, such as cod, flounder, haddock, halibut and sole (Cá, 鱼): refrigerate 1-2 days from date of purchase; freeze 6-8 months from date of purchase.

source: USDA FoodKeeper (public domain, CC0 1.0) - FSIS FoodKeeper Data v128
title: Tôm (虾, shrimp) — refrigerator and freezer storage
content: Shrimp and crayfish (Tôm, 虾): refrigerate 1-3 days from date of purchase; freeze 6-18 months from date of purchase.

source: USDA FoodKeeper (public domain, CC0 1.0) - FSIS FoodKeeper Data v128
title: Trứng gà (鸡蛋, eggs in shell) — refrigerator storage
content: Eggs in shell (Trứng gà, 鸡蛋): refrigerate 3-5 weeks from date of purchase. Freezing is not recommended.

source: USDA FoodKeeper (public domain, CC0 1.0) - FSIS FoodKeeper Data v128
title: Sữa tươi (鲜牛奶, milk) — refrigerator and freezer storage
content: Milk, plain or flavored (Sữa tươi, 鲜牛奶): refrigerate and follow the package use-by date; FoodKeeper lists no fixed number of days for refrigeration. Freeze 3 months from date of purchase.

source: USDA FoodKeeper (public domain, CC0 1.0) - FSIS FoodKeeper Data v128
title: Rau cải (青菜, leaf lettuce and spinach) — refrigerator storage
content: Leaf lettuce and spinach (Rau cải, 青菜): refrigerate 3-7 days from date of purchase. Freezing is not recommended.

source: USDA FoodKeeper (public domain, CC0 1.0) - FSIS FoodKeeper Data v128
title: Cà chua (番茄, tomatoes) — pantry and freezer storage
content: Tomatoes (Cà chua, 番茄): store in the pantry until ripe, then 7 days; USDA notes refrigeration may affect flavor and recommends pantry storage. Freeze 2 months from date of purchase.

source: USDA FoodKeeper (public domain, CC0 1.0) - FSIS FoodKeeper Data v128
title: Đậu phụ (豆腐, tofu) — refrigerator and freezer storage
content: Tofu (Đậu phụ, 豆腐): refrigerate 1 week from date of purchase; freeze 5 months from date of purchase.

source: USDA FoodKeeper (public domain, CC0 1.0) - FSIS FoodKeeper Data v128
title: Gạo (大米, white or wild rice) — pantry storage
content: White or wild rice (Gạo, 大米): store in the pantry 2 years from date of purchase; after opening, 1 year in the pantry or 6 months in the refrigerator.

source: USDA FoodKeeper (public domain, CC0 1.0) - FSIS FoodKeeper Data v128
title: Mì (面条, dry egg noodles) — pantry storage
content: Dry egg noodles (Mì, 面条): store in the pantry 2 years from date of purchase; after opening, 1-2 months in the pantry.

source: USDA FoodKeeper (public domain, CC0 1.0) - FSIS FoodKeeper Data v128
title: Hành tây (洋葱, onions) — pantry, refrigerator and freezer storage
content: Onions, yellow, white or red (Hành tây, 洋葱): store in the pantry 1 month from date of purchase; refrigerate 2 months from date of purchase; freeze 10-12 months from date of purchase.

source: USDA FoodKeeper (public domain, CC0 1.0) - FSIS FoodKeeper Data v128
title: Tỏi (大蒜, garlic) — pantry and refrigerator storage
content: Garlic (Tỏi, 大蒜): store unbroken bulbs in the pantry 1 month from date of purchase; store individual cloves in the refrigerator 3-14 days from date of purchase; freeze 1 month from date of purchase.

source: USDA FoodKeeper (public domain, CC0 1.0) - FSIS FoodKeeper Data v128
title: Gừng (生姜, ginger root) — pantry, refrigerator and freezer storage
content: Ginger root (Gừng, 生姜): store in the pantry 2-5 days from date of purchase; refrigerate 2-3 weeks from date of purchase; freeze 6 months from date of purchase.

source: Daikin Room Air Conditioner Operation Manual 3P196326-9B (manufacturer document, (c) Daikin)
title: Air conditioner — clean the air filter every two weeks (Daikin)
content: Daikin room air conditioner: clean the air filters once in about every two weeks (14 days). Clogged air filters cause inefficient operation and waste energy. Remove dust with a vacuum cleaner and gently rinse in cool water, then dry in the shade. Do not operate the air conditioner without filters.

source: Daikin Room Air Conditioner Operation Manual 3P196326-9B (manufacturer document, (c) Daikin)
title: Air conditioner — wash the deodorizing filter every six months (Daikin)
content: Daikin room air conditioner titanium apatite photocatalytic air-purifying (deodorizing) filter: renew by washing with water once every 6 months (180 days). Daikin recommends replacing it once every 3 years.

source: Beko Cooker Hood User Manual HCP 61310 XH/BH (manufacturer document, (c) Beko)
title: Range hood — clean the grease filter every month (Beko)
content: Beko cooker hood: the grease filter must be cleaned at least monthly (once a month, 30 days). Wash with non-aggressive detergent, by hand or in the dishwasher on a low temperature and short cycle. A grease filter that is not cleaned is a fire risk.

source: Beko Cooker Hood User Manual HCP 61310 XH/BH (manufacturer document, (c) Beko)
title: Range hood — replace the carbon filter every three months (Beko)
content: Beko cooker hood: the carbon (charcoal) filter must be replaced at least every 3 months (90 days). The carbon filter must never be washed.

source: Midea Air Purifier User Manual KJ600F-LM1P / KJ600G-RX600S / KJ600G-K10G (manufacturer document, (c) Midea)
title: Air purifier — clean the filter every two weeks, replace every six months (Midea)
content: Midea air purifier, models KJ600F-LM1P, KJ600G-RX600S and KJ600G-K10G: clean the filter every two weeks (14 days) and replace the filter every six months (180 days). Do not wash the filter with water; use a soft brush or a vacuum cleaner. The manual states: 建议两周清洁一次滤网，半年更换一次滤网。
